# Install and load packgages

```{r}
#| warning: false

.packages <- c(
    "renv",
    "dplyr",
    "purrr",
    "here",
    "tidyr",
    "magrittr",
    "devtools",
    # Plot
    "ComplexHeatmap",
    "MetBrewer",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork",
    "cowplot",
    # Single Cell
    "Seurat",
    "SeuratData",
    # Single Cell plotting
    "SCpubr",
    # Python alternatives
    "reticulate"
)
# Install
.installed_packages <- .packages %in%
    rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(.installed_packages == F)) {
    install.packages(.packages[!.installed_packages])
}
# Load
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    invisible(lapply(.packages, library, character.only = T))
})
```

# Set working directory

```{r}
directory <- here::here()
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
# Install
SeuratData::InstallData("bmcite")

bm <- SeuratData::LoadData(ds = "bmcite")
```

# Process

```{r}
Seurat::DefaultAssay(bm) <- 'RNA'

bm <- Seurat::NormalizeData(bm) %>%
  Seurat::FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  Seurat::ScaleData() %>%
  Seurat::RunPCA()

Seurat::DefaultAssay(bm) <- 'ADT'

Seurat::VariableFeatures(bm) <- rownames(bm[["ADT"]])

bm <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
  bm,
  normalization.method = 'CLR',
  # Normalize within cells
  margin = 2
) %>%
  Seurat::ScaleData() %>%
  Seurat::RunPCA(reduction.name = 'apca')

# Calculates the closest neighbors in the dataset
bm <- Seurat::FindMultiModalNeighbors(
  bm,
  reduction.list = list("pca", "apca"),
  dims.list = list(1:30, 1:18),
  modality.weight.name = "RNA.weight"
)
```
